messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide"
set: ["take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "antacid containing combination of aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "antacids containing aluminum or magnesium", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "2 hours", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "antacid", "stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "stop using at least 2 months before planning to get pregnant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
